synopsis: The Pretoria process is the University of Pretoria’s step-by-step method for independently verifying mining collision-avoidance systems [f15794]. The Vehicle Dynamics Group’s methodology, described in 2020, progresses from controlled laboratory tests to interaction tests in a representative mine, matching the Chapter 2 account of its progression into a mine [f15796, f1467]. It uses high-precision satellite positioning as surface ground truth and combinations of lidar, cameras and automotive radar underground [f15797]. The booklet concludes that this process leaves off-road validation far more physical than the automotive state of the art, while long queues at independent validation gates directly affect a four-month schedule; the supplied facts do not quantify those queues [f15809].

relations.note: Both describe progression into a representative mine; the glossary specifies preceding laboratory tests.
Specifies the group's identity, methodology date, and stages of the step-by-step verification process.
